says: In today's tooling, no law reaches the edge_unmarked finding of oxlint-plugins/tracked-scripts.ts: a malformed '# edge:' line, or one good and one malformed edge line in the same file, is never generated, so its tag, its message and the 'broken' rule can change without a red test.
proof: On a scratch copy, replacing 'broken: good.length < lines.length' with 'broken: false' (line 67), and separately returning new_script instead of edge_unmarked (line 86), each left oxlint-plugins/tracked-scripts.test.ts at 5 of 5 passed; the edge law compares only paths (tracked-scripts.test.ts:142).
cost: A file with one good edge line and one malformed one would pass lint after such a change, and the edge_unmarked message can drift with no test noticing.
